sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: FACS with M1 FLAG antibody confirmed plasma membrane surface display of the tagged receptor; receptor was used in glucagon-stimulated internalization experiments, confirming functional trafficking.
sites.rationale: The SSF-GCGR construct places a FLAG tag immediately after the signal peptide cleavage site (after residue 25, S; before residue 26, A), which is the canonical position for an N-terminal extracellular tag on a GPCR with a signal peptide. Python confirmed residue 25 = S and residue 26 = A. The tag sits 115 residues from TM1 (residue 141), well within the large extracellular N-terminal domain (26–140). Surface display was directly validated by M1 FLAG antibody FACS in stably expressing HEK293 cells. SSF-GCGR (signal sequence FLAG-tagged GCGR) construct expressed stably in HEK293 cells; FLAG tag is inserted after the signal peptide (residues 1–25) and before the mature N-terminus (residue 26), placing it on the extracellular face. Surface display confirmed by M1 FLAG antibody labeling and FACS analysis.

sources.claim: (F) Upon 30-min treatment with 1 μM glucagon, HEK293 cells stably expressing SSF-GCGR were labeled with M1 Flag antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647, fixed, and prepared for flow cytometry.

literature_notes: L3 also mentions a commercial pCMV6-GCGR-MycDDK construct (OriGene MR207767) but the tag position is unstated and cannot be pinned to a residue — disqualified per rules. L4 (GCGR-FLAG) and L5 (GCGR-GFP, C-terminal) both place tags at the intracellular C-terminus (residues 404–477) and are recorded in other_positions. L1, L2, and L3 all support the same SSF-GCGR junction; L1 is cited as the primary clip because it most explicitly documents surface display by FACS.

literature_other_positions.note: GCGR-FLAG construct used for immunoprecipitation/LC-MS/MS; C-terminal FLAG tag at residue 477 is intracellular per topology (intracellular domain 404–477).
C-terminal GFP-tagged GCGR expressed in HEK293T cells to monitor internalization; C-terminus at residue 477 is intracellular per topology (intracellular domain 404–477).
